verdict.rationale: Groq's docs and SDK show audio transcription (Whisper models via groq.audio.transcriptions) and vision input support in the Responses API (text+image inputs), demonstrating multimodal capability beyond text chat. However, no evidence of image-generation models being offered on the platform. Missing for 10: dedicated image-generation model documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of vision/audio quality, and any TTS/audio-output capability.
